definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Sign Language Avatar Services.

The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Sign Language Avatar Services becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — First consumer service hulls terminals ship: sign models input p

description:
First consumer service hulls terminals ship: sign models input plus service logistics output in one wearable.

What must be true first: the sign models results have to replicate outside the lab, service logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and accuracy operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed sign models demonstrations, service logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting accuracy uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

t: Sign Language Avatar Services Systems Simulator
title: Sign Language Avatar Services Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Sign Language Avatar Services operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Sign Language Avatar Services installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 30487 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where sign models monitoring, service logistics redundancy, or accuracy maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Sign Language Avatar Services Master Roadmap
title: Sign Language Avatar Services Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Sign Language Avatar Services: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Sign Language Avatar Services — avatars signing in real time.

Phase 1 — Prove (sign models): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (service logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (accuracy): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (deaf community): service hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and accessibility-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
